narrative.overview:
This is a source-derived native system, **not a visually verified design**. The user chose native iOS rather than a browser-shaped terminal application. SwiftUI platform controls carry the interface; the actual Plannotator page and SwiftTerm renderer retain their own content presentation.

The approved Apple Liquid Glass refresh adds a prettier, more magical native control layer without replacing the Operate identity or navigation. Surface-specific direction remains in [docs/IOS_SURFACE.md](docs/IOS_SURFACE.md).
keyCharacteristics: System-owned navigation, semantic colors and Dynamic Type.
Floating glass controls over opaque, readable content.
Explicit actions and state-driven feedback, never ambient animation.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Status always has text and an SF Symbol, never color alone; cached/unknown agents cannot appear ready. Appearance follows the system. The icon's fixed colors are artwork, not UI palette tokens.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Keep system text styles and SF Symbols; no custom display face. Accessibility-size rows stack title/status and remove title truncation. Draft lines and delivery-menu placement adapt to text size; actual clipping remains unverified.

rules.name: The Controls-Only Glass Rule
rules.body: Apple's iOS 26 `.glassEffect(.regular, in:)`, `.glass` and `.glassProminent` belong to controls; transcript, directory content and permission explanations stay opaque. Glass coverage includes navigation/menu/header actions, as explicitly requested by the user; it is not limited to the composer. Native bars remain system-owned. Explicit glass toolbar buttons use `mobileGlassHeaderItem` to hide only their iOS 26 shared toolbar background, avoiding a second glass layer; native back navigation is not replaced. `GlassEffectContainer(spacing: 8)` shares rendering across adjacent controls without merging their resting shapes.

rules.name: The State-Only Motion Rule
rules.body: Dictation and iOS 26 Agent/Terminal selection changes use `.smooth(duration: 0.25)` unless Reduce Motion is enabled; status/dictation symbol bounces are state-triggered and suppressed under Reduce Motion. Selection haptics follow native tab/pane changes; success feedback follows the host acknowledgment. Navigation pushes/sheets remain system transitions. Streaming text is not animated; no ambient loops or custom entrance choreography.

dos: Do preserve platform navigation, semantic colors, Dynamic Type and SF Symbols.
Do keep glass on controls, content opaque and accessibility fallbacks native.
Do distinguish unknown/unreachable state from a verified empty directory.
Do tie motion to state, honor Reduce Motion and await host acknowledgment for success feedback.
Do capture native screenshots in both appearances, keyboard/landscape and large text sizes before claiming visual readiness.
donts: Don't use browser screenshots, fake HTML/CSS glass or mock conversations as evidence of the native app.
Don't substitute fixed hex palettes for dynamic system colors or UI tokens for icon artwork.
Don't add decorative dashboard metrics, ambient animation, custom navigation gestures or notification controls.
Don't treat compilation or resolved source findings as a visual verdict.
